answer: Make validation seats escrow distinct collateral for 30 epochs, with a ledger nullifier preventing the same coin from backing two keys. At each pulse, a lantern audit plants a claim whose signature is provably invalid; a signed echo of it forfeits that seat’s entire bond. A farm can share one model to spot traps, its cheapest move, but each identity still immobilizes a separate bond for 30 epochs; a common mistake slashes every key that signs it. Reused collateral voids extra seats, while skipping the audit risks the bond on every clone.
